description: Le Bon Road Trip Planner lets you find your saved trips and create or update itineraries, stops, notes, travel stories, places, photos, and budgets directly in ChatGPT. Every action is limited to the connected account, and trip-related results include a link to review changes in the Planner.

defaultPrompt: Affiche mes voyages enregistrés dans Le Bon Road Trip.

Ouvre mon itinéraire Islande et ajoute une nuit à Akureyri.
